title: The Outsider
subtitle: Under the bricks and stones, few plants can vegetate here.

items.text: The Outsider

items.speaker: Foundation Staff
items.text: Ms. Druvis, we are waiting for your response.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Now ... I am the last to be invited.

items.speaker: Foundation Staff
items.text: Is there anything else that concerns you, Ms. Druvis?

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: When will my friends come back?

items.speaker: Foundation Staff
items.text: They are waiting for you outside the suitcase, just as we are. All we want is an opportunity to talk to you face to face.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Please wait a moment.
There is no time to feel attached to the past.
She looks at the brown granules in her palm. These are seeds of trees.
As she wags the fingers, the seeds are sprinkled on the ground by the stairs. They quickly roll and disappear in the gaps and crevices.
SPDM Library
Her friends are not here, of course.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: May I ask ... where we are?

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: The library, a place where people let down their guards.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Trust always facilitates cooperation, don't you think?

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: ... But I don't even know your name.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: The name is Constantine. I'm the vice president of the Joint Committee of the Foundation.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Please allow me to extend a welcome on behalf of the Foundation.
She taps her pen on the table and calls out a thin pile of documents. The signatures are left blank on the paper.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: We have sent this document into that suitcase days ago. I should assume that you have read it.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: What's your conclusion then, Ms. Weyerhaeuser?

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Are you referring to ... inviting Sotheby, Mr. APPLe and me to join the Foundation?

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: We need to discuss this with Vertin before we give you a proper response.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: We don't know much about the Foundation. As far as I'm concerned ... I do not yet intend to join any organization.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: That is to say, you are inclined to turn down my proposal.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: My apologies ... Vertin has not only been of great help to us, but also saved us from the "Storm."

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: I cannot accept the invitation without her opinion, neither can I make decisions for others.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Fair enough.
Constantine gets up on her feet and walks to the other side of the table.
There stands an unfinished card tower.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: You, who accidentally and rather luckily escaped from the "Storm" in 1929 and now seek refuge from the Foundation—Weyerhaeuser, Sotheby, and APPLe. You are the spire of the tower.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Between you and the Foundation, the storeys in the middle, are our investigators who go out to rescue the wandering arcanists and humans.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Vertin, is one of them.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Merely a drop in the ocean.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Vertin indeed is the key to connect you and the Foundation.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: But let's not forget, only an entity as massive and powerful as the Foundation can provide you with long-lasting protection.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Without the Foundation's supplies, manpower, and technology, even Vertin can barely sail against the great tides of history, let alone the ordinary people, whose fate is doomed to struggle in the endless hazards of time.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Open your eyes and take a look ...

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: We, are the unshakable fortress you should rely on.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Do you still wish to talk to Vertin first?

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: She is receiving a treatment from us.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Which means she won't make it back by your side before any decision is made.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Her suitcase will also be retrieved for research purposes after the meeting. As compensation for your displacement, we will arrange you a more decent room.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Ms. Z will show you around the headquarters tomorrow.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Go walk around and meet some people ... Perhaps it will help you see what the most beneficial choice to all of us will be.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: I will wait for your answer.

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: But ...

items.speaker: Constantine
items.text: Don't keep me waiting for too long.
TO BE CONTINUED…
